meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 它会把整个代码库从9个维度逐项检查,找出技术债(如代码重复、类型漏洞、测试缺失等),每处都标注文件位置和严重级别。最后生成 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md 报告,列出修复优先级和工作量估算。
howto.when: 当你要求做代码库健康检查、技术债审计、架构评审等,或提到“tech debt”“code health”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我的代码库做一次技术债审计
检查一下代码健康度,找出最需要优先修的问题
say.note: 会输出按影响与工时排序的 Top 5 优先级名单。

say.text: 审计代码质量,列出所有严重和高优先级的技术债
say.note: 每处问题都会标注文件位置和严重级别。

howto.what_en: Performs a file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep, grep, language-native tools, and optionally CodeGraph. Produces a TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md report with severity ratings, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, etc., or when mentioning keywords like 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', etc.

say_en.text: Run a technical debt audit on my codebase.
say_en.note: It checks all 9 dimensions and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md.

say_en.text: Check code health and list the most urgent fixes first.
say_en.note: Outputs the top 5 priorities ranked by impact vs effort.

say_en.text: Audit code quality and list all critical and high-severity debt.
say_en.note: Each finding is cited with file:line:col and severity.
